summary: Fix pass committed (613cd3b): the phases and criteria now follow the reversed Ruling D2. P1 adds architectureProducer as steps and rewrites the two architecture reference files on them with no guide rule changed, and P2-P4 make all 78 producers full declarative files that call the steps (IoTSupport's KEYCLOAK global is the one recorded exception). V05, V09, V10 and V11 now carry the collector order, the API-write scope, a checkable no-rule-change test and the linter check of every producer file. Close-out P1 is struck as moot, and B1 and P2 are noted.
